app-templates.message:
feat(interactive): a slot in the heading line, an optional heading and a wider frame

## Intent

On the app page of an interactive app, the app's name appeared twice in a row: as the header link and as the h1. The heading line had no place for a small control of the app. Apps worked around this with their own heading line, CSS that hides the runtime's h1, and an overridden frame width. The runtime should offer this cleanly (lernapps/tooling#111).

## Key changes

- The app page renders its heading line as one row: the h1 and a slot beside it. The slot stays hidden and empty unless the app passes a component as startInteractive(core, App, { title }); it gets the root component's props and input event.
- app.yaml may give a heading per language for the h1 of the app page; without it the h1 is the title, as before. The start page, the page titles and the no-JavaScript note do not change.
- Header, page and footer are as wide as --interactive-max-width (default 44rem).
- The schema, the architecture of the template and the tests cover heading and slot.
